description: REQ-506's own Acceptance Criteria (behavioral-spec.md, spec-review iteration-2 FIND-101 regression test) explicitly names a required test, 'PROP-506f ("empty-safe-set-escalates")': 'A unit test with a fixture always-act menu whose only members besides the just-picked (capital-risking) slot are ALSO risk:"capital" ... asserts zero additional think() calls and immediate REQ-508 escalation -- never a reroute into a risk:"capital" slot.' This scenario is DISTINCT from every one of the 12 rows in behavioral-spec.md sec2.5's transition matrix (all of which assume either an immediate accept, a reprompt, or a NON-empty reroute-target set) -- it is index.mjs's `rerouteTargets.length === 0` branch (index.mjs:789-795), reached when the risk-free-filtered reroute set is empty even though other (non-safe) slots remain. A comprehensive grep across every always-act-*.test.mjs file for 'PROP-506f', 'empty-safe-set', 'reroute-target-is-risk-free', and the general pattern 'risk-free.*empty|empty.*reroute' returns ZERO matches -- this named, spec-mandated test does not exist anywhere in the 62-test suite this sprint claims. This is also the ONLY code path that could exercise REQ-510's own second literal-domain-pin Acceptance Criterion ('a unit test for REQ-506's empty-reroute-target terminal case ... asserts the ledgered attemptsUsed value is literally 0 even though exactly ONE think() call was actually made -- this is the case that falsifies the think()-call-count reading') -- that AC is therefore also entirely untested. Manual trace of index.mjs:779-795 confirms the CODE correctly passes the pre-increment `attemptsUsed` (not `state.attemptsUsedNext`) to writeAlwaysActEscalation in this branch, so the implementation is plausibly correct on this specific point -- but this is exactly the tautological-coverage class of gap iteration-1's FIND-001 already flagged once in this same sprint (a test suite reporting green while a spec-mandated, money-safety-adjacent branch is never actually exercised by any test).

additionalEvidence.snippet: **(spec-review iteration-2 FIND-101 regression test, PROP-506f "empty-safe-set-escalates")** A unit test with a fixture always-act menu whose only members besides the just-picked (capital-risking) slot are ALSO risk:"capital" ... asserts zero additional think() calls and immediate REQ-508 escalation -- never a reroute into a risk:"capital" slot.

A unit test for REQ-506's empty-reroute-target terminal case ... asserts the ledgered attemptsUsed value is literally 0 even though exactly ONE think() call was actually made -- this is the case that falsifies the think()-call-count reading and confirms the field ledgers attemptsUsed in {0, 1} exclusively.

testCoverageNote: grep -n 'PROP-506f|empty-safe-set|reroute-target-is-risk-free' across runtime/loop/__tests__/always-act-*.test.mjs: zero matches. grep -n '^test\(' against always-act-reroute.test.mjs and always-act-router.test.mjs enumerated every one of the 30 test names in this sprint's target-feature suite; none matches this scenario.
